title: Integral-closure normalization of moduli groupoids on scheme charts
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use the categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, morphisms, 2-isomorphisms, scheme presentations and 2-fibre products of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For $v:\mathcal V	o\mathcal X$, $a:\mathcal N	o\mathcal X$, $i:\mathcal V	o\mathcal N$ and a specified 2-isomorphism $e:ai\simeq v$, define the chart-normalization condition as follows. A map of moduli groupoids is representable etale when every scheme 2-base change admits an algebraic-space presentation etale over the test scheme [def-weil-etale-morphism]. For every normal finite-type scheme $T/S$ and representable etale $t:h_T	o\mathcal X$, there are a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism $p:E	o T$ and an equivalence $h_E\simeq h_T	imes_{\mathcal X}\mathcal V$ over $h_T$. Here normal means all local rings are normal domains [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]; finite type and quasi-compactness are [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and quasi-separatedness is [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Form the actual relative normalization $p^
u:E^
u	o T$: on an affine open $W$ of $T$ its ring is the integral closure of $\Gamma(T,W)$ in $\Gamma(E,p^{-1}W)$, and glue these rings by localization. It has the canonical dominant map $j:E	o E^
u$. Require an equivalence $h_{E^
u}\simeq h_T	imes_{\mathcal X}\mathcal N$ over $h_T$ whose composite with $h_j$ is 2-isomorphic to the map induced from $h_E$ by $i$ and $e$. All these comparisons retain their arrows and specified isomorphisms. For a normal finite cover of a dense open in a normal Noetherian chart this integral closure is equivalently taken in the product of the function fields of all its generic components, with no factor omitted. This is a predicate on the specified maps, not an assertion that any normalization exists.
